how-a-village-kitchen-feeds-300-families.lead: Every morning in Bundelkhand, 18 local women prepare fresh harvests from nearby farms to serve over 1,100 hot meals with dignity.
how-a-village-kitchen-feeds-300-families.quote: The kitchen is where neighbors know they never stand alone.
keyTakeaways: 1,100+ hot meals served six days a week
100% of grains sourced from local women farmers
Reusable steel plates with zero plastic waste

sections.title: Morning preparation rooted in pride
sections.description: At 5:30 AM, our team checks fresh spinach, lentils, and millets purchased at fair rates from smallholder farmers within ten kilometers.

sections.title: Warm meals for 300 families at noon
sections.description: Students and elderly residents gather in the shaded courtyard for wholesome meals that have cut school absenteeism by 41%.

back-to-school-supplies-update.lead: A school bag, solar lamp, and hands-on science kit transform how rural students begin their school term.
back-to-school-supplies-update.quote: When every child has the tools to learn, the whole classroom thrives.
keyTakeaways: Solar study lamps for evening reading at home
Hands-on STEM modules for grades 5 to 8

sections.title: Designed with village teachers
sections.description: Our education team worked with local headmasters to build STEM kits that match the school curriculum.

sections.title: 98% daily classroom attendance
sections.description: Providing uniforms, books, and solar lamps removed enrollment barriers and boosted attendance to 98%.

volunteer-spotlight.lead: Three years ago, Anil joined a single Saturday book drive—and has returned for 140 weekends to build village libraries.
volunteer-spotlight.quote: You only need to keep showing up and making one useful difference each week.

sections.title: Weather-proof courtyard libraries
sections.description: Anil helped village committees design durable book chests that turn shaded courtyards into afternoon reading hubs.

sections.title: Mentoring local youth fellows
sections.description: Today, college youth fellows run the reading circles daily across all 18 partner villages.

where-your-donation-goes.lead: In our 2026 audit, 94% of every contribution went directly into village classrooms, kitchens, and medical vans.
where-your-donation-goes.quote: Transparency is a promise we keep with every supporter and village partner.

sections.title: Co-signed village ledgers
sections.description: Every project ledger is co-signed by our finance desk and the local village committee.

sections.title: Direct regional sourcing
sections.description: Buying supplies from local farmers and artisans keeps overhead low while strengthening village economies.

mobile-health-clinic-reaches-remote-vill.lead: For families 40 kilometers from the nearest town, our mobile medical van brings primary care right to their courtyard.
mobile-health-clinic-reaches-remote-vill.quote: Compassionate care starts with meeting families where they are.
keyTakeaways: 24 village women trained as health guides

sections.title: Solar-equipped medical van
sections.description: Carrying cold-chain vaccines, diagnostics, and free essential medicines on a fixed schedule.

sections.title: Preventive wellness workshops
sections.description: Trained village health guides lead courtyard sessions on clean water and maternal nutrition.

winter-food-packs-for-families.lead: Ahead of winter frost, our volunteer hubs pack warm quilts and 30-day dry ration boxes for 400 mountain households.
winter-food-packs-for-families.quote: A winter kit brings practical warmth and the care of a wider community.
keyTakeaways: Quilts stitched by rural women's cooperatives
Last-mile delivery with local youth volunteers

sections.title: Crafted by women's cooperatives
sections.description: Every quilt is stitched by local self-help groups, creating fair winter livelihoods.

sections.title: Timely doorstep delivery
sections.description: Volunteers work with village elders so elderly residents and young families receive kits before the first frost.
